title: Elux Legend Lemonade Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Elux Legend Lemonade Nic Salt captures the crisp refreshment of freshly squeezed Lemonade. Zesty citrus notes meet a light sugary sweetness to create a bright, sparkling flavour that is clean, sharp, and perfect for everyday vaping. Crafted with double-concentrated flavouring, the Elux Legend Nic Salt range is designed to offer a punchier, more intense taste experience that echoes the most recognisable Elux profiles. With a balanced 50% VG and 50% PG ratio, alongside a smooth nicotine salt formulation, Lemonade is ideal for use with MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and starter devices. It provides a well-rounded combination of flavour, vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths.
